purpose: Evaluate whether frozen TACHYON R5F mirror (C->B->A) adds safe provenance/forward replay checking of JANUS COSMOS R42A8A synthetic radio candidates, without changing detector decisions.

source_pins.frozen_model_source: R42A7A shadow score from R42A8A protocol, original authentic GitHub Actions model artifact SHA checked before use
source_pins.source_label: Frozen research model, not production JANUS SETI detector

dataset.candidate_path: Actual R42A8A blind_line_candidate applied to identical simulated spectra before any labels, no ground-truth trajectory as feature
dataset.frozen_score: Actual R42A7A signed shadow score computed from R42A7A features, no training or thresholds
dataset.quality_labels: Original generator labels used only after decisions for descriptive AUC; not a physical telescope source origin or real RFI truth.

graph_bridge.A: Synthetic time-frequency spectrum row, byte-level sha256 evidence handle
graph_bridge.B: COSMOS blind 16-sample candidate frequency path, hash and original array index
graph_bridge.C: Frozen R42A7A shadow score, hash and candidate reference
graph_bridge.physical_event_time: No real observation timestamps exist; no fictitious clocks or independent physical witnesses will be introduced
graph_bridge.mirror: Build synthetic R5F-compatible graph A->B->C, then call pinned TACHYON mirror_case to transpose C->B->A; verify mirror path returns source identity and evidence handles; validate all metadata by forward replay
graph_bridge.provenance_mode: Simulation source and computation provenance only, no independent physical sensor provenance

adversarial_overlay.definition: Perturb metadata claims only. Original spectrograms, native COSMOS model scores, detector candidate paths, outcome labels and frozen weights remain unchanged.
adversarial_overlay.no_label_dependency: Assign overlay permutation using an independent fixed RNG without reference to simulated positive/null labels.
adversarial_overlay.objective: All 128 intact accepted; all 896 damaged/incomplete metadata rejected by complete forward/reverse audit, with zero incorrect confident provenance acceptances.
adversarial_overlay.limitation: Toy corruption categories chosen by our own development suite, not externally authored adversarial corruptions

paired_arms.A_COSMOS_ONLY: Existing native COSMOS synthetic candidate and frozen shadow score accepted without provenance audit; no modification to scores or decisions
paired_arms.B_TACHYON_MIRROR_GRAPH_ONLY: Pinned mirror_case+mirrored_exact, no full digest/model/source proof, weak ablation
paired_arms.C_TACHYON_MIRROR_FORWARD_REPLAY: Pinned mirror_case+mirrored_replay, plus source/raw-path-score/model SHA comparison and reverse proposals to frozen authoritative DAG
paired_arms.D_STRONG_DIRECT_PROVENANCE: Strong transparent exact direct graph/digest check on same data, no TACHYON mirror

metrics: All native R42A8A 1024 spectrogram score/candidate path parity, two baseline AUCs descriptive
Per-arm accepted candidate metadata, rejection count and unsupported accepts of corrupted records
Preservation of original 1024 frozen model scores and candidate paths exactly, 0 automatic vetoes
Paired coverage and unsupported metadata acceptance vs strong direct baseline, correctness of 128 intact
Postprocessing time and counted graph operations; full detector feature extraction costs separately stated, no unsupported speedup claim
expected_interpretation: Mirrored audit may catch corrupted metadata vs unverified COSMOS-only, but cannot be called an increase in astronomical sensitivity or superiority to strong exact provenance checking. Strong direct replay is mandatory comparator.
